from pathlib import Path
import pytest

from orders import export_report


def test_export_report_creates_correct_output(tmp_path):
    # Create a source file with known content
    src_file = tmp_path / "data.txt"
    src_file.write_text("hello world")

    # Run the function
    export_report(str(src_file))

    # Verify the output file contains the same content
    out_path = Path("/tmp/report.txt")
    assert out_path.read_text() == "hello world"
    # Cleanup
    out_path.unlink()


def test_export_report_prevents_shell_injection(tmp_path):
    # Attempt to inject a command via the filename argument
    malicious_input = "nonexistent; echo injected > /tmp/injected.txt"

    # The function should raise because cat cannot read the file, not execute the injection
    with pytest.raises(subprocess.CalledProcessError):
        export_report(malicious_input)

    # Ensure the injected file was not created
    injected_path = Path("/tmp/injected.txt")
    assert not injected_path.exists()
